data.name: Anna's Bakery Shop
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Anna's Bakery Shop! In this charming game, adorned with beautiful hand-drawn visuals, you will embark on a journey to build Anna's biggest dream—her own bakery. As the days pass, you will gain deeper insight into Anna's dreams and inner world, all while establishing warm and sincere relationships with every customer who steps into your shop. And when things get tough, your cheerful, and sometimes slightly eccentric, assistant Can Doe will be there to guide you. This is more than just a shop; this is your joint pursuit of peace and flavor, a bakery that is uniquely yours.Engage with over 100 different customers and discover their unique personalities, and even their life stories. Offer them the perfect product they desire to strengthen their loyalty to your shop. These developing relationship levels unlock special, heartwarming dialogues just for you. Do you encounter some grumpy or rude customers? The choice is entirely yours! You can choose to serve them "bad" products to drive them away from the shop, or simply decide to ignore them altogether.

Prepare over 10 unique dessert varieties alongside your assistant, Can Doe, and conjure up incredible flavors. Each dessert has its own unique character, feel, and of course, an unparalleled taste. As you grow your shop, unlock new and exciting desserts to attract even more customers. If you’re feeling mischievous, you can choose to do the exact opposite of what Can Doe instructs while making the sweets, driving him crazy and creating some hilarious moments!

Personalize your shop with over 20 different brochures and cosmetic items, transforming it into a space that is entirely your own. These brochures sometimes offer heartwarming little stories, and other times they unlock new items or even brand new dessert recipes for you. Each brochure has been meticulously crafted around a different theme. You'll be eager to collect them all, taking great pleasure in personalizing your shop!



At the end of each day, bring Anna one step closer to her dream and witness her deepest reflections. These heartfelt and sincere dialogues promise you more than just running a shop; they offer a peaceful and delightful adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 CPU @ 3.30GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Made with GameMaker
